title: fix(cloudflare): set default image transformation quality
body:
## Changes

Cloudflare has a weird, undocumented, behavior for webp (and possibly other formats) where if you set the quality to `undefined` or 100, it'll attempt a lossless encoding, resulting in insanely large images. The Image people at Cloudflare suggested that I just set a default quality at the Astro level to palliate this.

Fixes https://github.com/withastro/astro.build/issues/2611

## Testing

Added tests

## Docs

N/A. This is in line with the behavior we already have in Astro itself and in the other adapters, Cloudflare is the only outlier here.
